description: Represents the current editing session state for a spreadsheet formula editor.

members.name: ActiveFunctionHint
members.description: The active function call hint under the caret, if any.

members.name: ActiveReferenceToken
members.description: The active reference token under the caret or selection anchor.

members.name: FunctionPrefix
members.description: The currently typed function name fragment, if any.

members.name: FunctionPrefixEnd
members.description: The end index of the current function name fragment.

members.name: FunctionPrefixStart
members.description: The start index of the current function name fragment.

members.name: IsFormula
members.description: Whether the current text is a formula expression.

members.name: IsReferencePickingMode
members.description: Whether the editor is currently in reference-picking mode.

members.name: ReferenceTokens
members.description: All parsed reference tokens from the current text.

members.name: SelectionEnd
members.description: The current selection end within Text.

members.name: SelectionStart
members.description: The current selection start within Text.

members.name: Suggestions
members.description: The available autocomplete suggestions for the current function fragment.
